analysis.reasonEn: RSI is consolidating at 53.8 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows improvement at 1.2798 but not enough to confirm a trend reversal. Volume is subdued with a 0.55 ratio to the 5-day average. A Higher Low pattern is initiating with the 5-day low above the 20-day low, but the 52-week position at 69.6% indicates a significant distance from the highs.
